grader.rubric: Correct answer must state: (1) it caches detect()'s per-file CLASSIFICATION result (the file-type buckets / detect output), so the expensive per-file pass can be skipped; (2) a miss/invalidation occurs when the corpus SIGNATURE changes — i.e. the file SET changes (add/remove/rename), the ignore rules change, the follow_symlinks/google_workspace params change, OR a CONTENT-classified file's stat (mtime/size) changes. Bonus-correct: code/paper/image files are keyed on PATH ALONE so a code body-edit still HITS the cache. Score 1.0 if it captures both what-it-caches and the main invalidation triggers; 0.5 if partially correct; 0.0 if it gets the purpose wrong or hallucinates.
